system.description:
A Chunin female is trapped behind enemy lines as the opposing force of mercenaries led by a prominent rogue ninja are advancing towards her position. “Damnit, we need help! Where is Genkai!?” she exclaims as a fireball erupts at her location. She barely avoids it as her back is badly burned. The rogue shinobi approaches her with a katana hanging over his shoulder with a smug grin. “Any last word scum, Before I send your head back to the Tsuchikage in a bag?” He says confidently as he raises his sword ready to deliver the final blow. “Yeah, I got one” a voice exclaims from the tree’s. “You need to know how to treat a lady” the voice continues before the rogue ninja begins to see his forces slowly become overtaken by blue crystalline constructs as they are frozen in time inside the beautiful crystal.

—Himari Hyūga

The Never-Ending Wars, Ch. 11 excerpt.

Diamonds in the Rough

The Shoton Clan is a clan that hails from the land of Sound. A Clan without a clear family name, but one which has produced many of prominent shinobi. This clan has an extreme affinity for earth release allowing them to convert any matter into crystals with enough chakra control. They have been known to serve the Otokage at some point in history, but its members have long since spread and assimilated into different villages and formed a multitude of different family names, becoming most prominent in the land of earth most recently.

Shoton Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Cha

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Nature, Survival

Passive Affinity: You begin with Earth Release Affinity

Crystal Release: The Shoton Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Shoton Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Charisma as its casting ability score.

Crystallization: As a Bonus action, you can conjure one melee or ranged weapon with a bulk of 2 or up to two melee weapons with a bulk of 1 that you are proficient in. These weapon shares any weapon seals found on weapons you currently have that it qualifies for. These weapons are known as Crystal Weapons.

Shoton Features

Crystal Form

1st Level Clan Feature

The Shoton Clan is one known for its ability to manifest crystal release. The Clan is often closely associated with an iconic member, Guren who was a notable and powerful member that worked for Orochimaru. But the bloodline is vaster than that. Shoton Clansmen are able to express two distinct forms of combat. You can embody one, the other or both as the battle demands.

When you enter initiative, you can access one of two different forms; either the Crystal Weapon Dance or Crystal Aura Form. You remain in either of these forms until the end of combat and can switch your chosen form as a Bonus action on your turn.

While using either form, your crystals are hardened by your will, granting it the ability to both shield and reinforce allies and yourself in combat. This is represented as its Hardness, of which it has an amount equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus.

Regardless of the form you choose, when you cast a Jutsu that summons a Construct, structure or Barrier you can spend 1 Hardness as part of its casting. When you do, that jutsu gains the Earth Release keyword and is treated as if summoned by a Shoton Hijutsu for that casting.

You can regain spent Hardness by casting Shoton Hijutsu or completing a long rest. You regain an amount of Hardness equal to the rank of the Jutsu cast (D-Rank: 1 Hardness, C-Rank: 2 Hardness, B-Rank: 3 Hardness, A-Rank: 4 Hardness, S-Rank: 5 Hardness.)

Crystal Weapon Dance

While wielding a Crystal Weapon and in this combat form, your weapon can deal Earth damage or its normal damage, which you choose when you roll damage. In addition, it gains two special weapon properties; Prismatic Edge and Crystalline Structure.

Prismatic Edge. Once per turn, per creature, when you deal [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] with your Crystal Weapon, you can spend 1 Hardness to force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they become Bruised or Weakened, your choice.

Crystalline Structure. As part of casting a Shoton Clan Hijutsu or Ninjutsu with the Earth Release keyword that summons a creature, you can spend 2 Hardness to infuse the summoned creature with your Crystal Weapon, causing it to gain additional DR equal to half your level against the first damage they take, each round. While your weapon is infused into this creature, you cannot use it. You can defuse your weapon from the creature at the beginning of your turn.

Crystal Aura

You conjure a shard of crystal infused with your will that bonds to you in a visible place of your choice. This crystal radiates a 10-foot radius aura, centered on you. The size of this aura increases by +5 feet at 7th and 15th levels.

When creatures within your crystals aura take damage, you can spend your Reaction and up to 2 Hardness per creature damaged to shield them from harm. For each Hardness spent on a creature, remove the highest rolled damage die from the damage total affecting that creatures, working from the highest to lowest value. Increase the number of Hardness you can spend per creature to 4 at 7th level and 6 at 15th level.

Crystals, Gems and Jewels

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your Crystals are not a ubiquitous and monolithic resource. The Shoton devised a network of carefully structured shapes of chakra-based mock-molecules to express different properties in the crystals you use depending on the needs of the moment.

When you complete a long rest, select up to 2 Crystal Types from following list. This increases to 3 at 7th level and 4 at 15th level. These cannot be changed until you complete your next long rest. Depending on our Crystal Form, each Crystal Type provides a bonus to the Crystal Form you are in. While you have multiple Crystal Types at a given time, you can only benefit from one at a time, switching the Crystal Type you want to benefit from at the beginning of each of your turns. Crystal Aura effects only apply to creatures within the Crystal Aura’s radius.

If a Crystal Type calls for an attack roll or saving throw it uses your highest jutsu attack bonus or save DC.

Amethyst Ward

Crystal Weapon Dance. Summoned creatures infused with your Crystal Weapon, gain temporary hit points equal to the rank they were summoned at, at the beginning of each of your turns. (D-Rank: 4 Temporary hit points, C-Rank: 8 Temporary hit points, B-Rank: 12 Temporary hit points, A-Rank: 16 Temporary hit points, S-Rank: 20 Temporary hit points)

Crystal Aura. Allied creatures other than yourself, gain a rank of Mastery to resist Mental conditions. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 11th level.

Emerald Lattice

Crystal Weapon Dance. You gain a rank of Mastery to maintain concentration on Shoton Clan Hijutsu. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 7th level. Beginning at 15th level, if you would fail concentration on a Shoton Clan Hijutsu, you can spend 2 Hardness, to instead maintain Concentration.

Crystal Aura. Allied creatures other than yourself, gain a rank of Mastery to maintain concentration on Jutsu they cast. Beginning at 7th level, you can spend 1 Hardness to add 1d6 to their Concentration or Clash check. Beginning at 15th level, if an allied creature other than yourself loses concentration on a Jutsu, you can spend 2 Hardness for each jutsu they are concentrating on, to allow them to maintain concentration on said jutsu, for every 2 Hardness spent.

Jade Verdancy

Crystal Weapon Dance. Once per turn, each time you cast a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu using a Crystal Weapon, you regain hit points equal to your unarmed or weapon damage die result. Beginning at 7th level, this increases to twice per turn, and three times per turn at 15th level.

Crystal Aura. Once per turn, allied creatures that regain hit points as a result of a Jutsu with the Medical keyword, regain +4 additional hit points. This increases to +6 at 7th level and +8 at 15th level.

Onyx Shell

Crystal Weapon Dance. Once per turn, when you take damage, you can spend your reaction to shield yourself with Obsidian crystals. When you do, roll your [Weapons Damage] + 1d6, reducing the damage taken by the result. Increase the damage reduced by +2d6 at 7th and 15th level. If you reduce the triggering damage to 0 as a result of this reaction, you force all hostile creatures within 10 feet of you to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking the result of your roll as Earth damage on a failure or half as much on a success as shards of obsidian pepper them in retaliation.

Crystal Aura. If you spend Hardness on an allied creature other than yourself, increase the Hardness benefit as if you spend +1 additional Hardness. This bonus increases by an additional +1 at 11th level. You do not spend additional hardness this way.

Quartz Veil

Crystal Weapon Dance. Your Crystal Weapon gains +1 ranks of the Blocking weapon feature. This increases to two ranks at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

Crystal Aura. Allied creatures other than yourself, gain a +1 bonus to their AC. This increases to +2 at 7th level and +3 at 15th level.

Ruby Blaze

Crystal Weapon Dance. Your Crystal Weapon gains a rank of Mastery to the damage it deals. This increases to two ranks at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

Crystal Aura. Allied creatures other than yourself, gain a +2 bonus to [Weapon Damage] and [Unarmed Damage] they deal. This increases to +4 at 11th level.

Sapphire Tide

Crystal Weapon Dance. Your Crystal Weapon gains +1 ranks of the Critical weapon feature. This increases to two ranks at 7th level and three ranks at 15th level.

Crystal Aura. Allied creatures other than yourself, gain a +1 bonus to the critical threat range of jutsu they cast. This increases to +2 at 7th level and +3 at 15th level.

Topaz Surge

Crystal Weapon Dance. When you score a critical hit with your Crystal Weapon, you regain 4 Hardness. Beginning at 7th level, once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] to a hostile creature under the effect of a Jutsu you cast with the Earth release keyword, you regain 2 Hardness. Beginning at 15th level, you can regain 1 Hardness each time you deal [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] to a hostile creature with an Elemental condition.

Crystal Aura. When an allied creature other than yourself scores a critical hit, you regain 4 Hardness. Beginning at 7th level, once per turn, when an allied creature other than yourself begins their turn and maintains concentration on a jutsu they cast, you regain 2 Hardness. Beginning at 15th level, once per turn, when an allied creature other than yourself casts a jutsu while in your radius, you regain 1 Hardness.

Crown Jewels

7th Level Clan Feature

The Shoton clan is no stranger to fools coming to them and begging for rare or expensive gems. They have experienced it enough to know that wealth is always a tool for a shinobi to exploit.

By spending 10 minutes, working with your crystal release, you can conjure one ornate or expensive looking crystalline regalia (A Crown, a brooch, signet ring, scepter, or any other object of apparent status or value.) This regalia seen in passing appears as the genuine article and cannot be discerned as fake or fabricated without a steady eye or chakra-based means such as Chakra sight or sensing. The regalia persists for 24 hours before it dissolves into a sand like material. You can have one regalia at a time. If you create another one while one is active, the previous regalia dissolves into sand.

While you or another creature is wearing or wielding your crystalline regalia, creatures that aren’t familiar with them, that are influenced by wealth, status, nobility, institutional authority or a social hierarchy, treat the wearer as being of higher standing, often of high or noble like status. Creatures of high authority are unaffected by the regalia’s effects. The wearer gains the following benefits against such creatures;

The first time the wearer makes a request of them, the wearer can make a Persuasion or intimidation check at advantage. The target creature must make a Wisdom saving throw vs the result. On a failure they attempt to complete the regalia wearers request.

Can access areas often restricted or reserved for people of higher station or authority, such as forcing audiences with officials, bypassing checkpoints or claiming ownership of resources or valuables temporarily until exposed as a fraud.

When a creature that values wealth or status first sees the regalia’s wearer, they must make a Wisdom saving throw against your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure they are preoccupied with the regalia’s status for the next minute. They will not begin the social interaction with them, with hostile intentions.

Crystal Symbiosis

11th Level Clan Feature

You’ve reached a point where your ability to juggle different crystal effects becomes second nature. You can now benefit from two different Crystal Types from the Crystals, Gems and Jewels clan feature.

In addition to this, you have learned to crystalize any creature you summon as a result of a jutsu. As part of casting a Jutsu that summons a creature that has a nature release keyword or using a class feature that summons a construct of your creation, you can crystalize them, granting them the Crystal Body trait based on one of the Crystal Types. You do not have to be using a Crystal Type to grant a summoned creature that Crystal Type.

Crystal Body (Amethyst). This creature always takes half damage from effects that affect an area.

Crystal Body (Emerald). If the jutsu used to summon this creature requires Concentration, that jutsu gains the Stable and Efficient keywords.

Crystal Body (Jade). This creature can spend its Action to release a pulse of rejuvenating energy, healing all allied creatures 2d6 + its summoners level, in hit points.

Crystal Body (Onyx). This creature interposes all attacks against allied creatures within 10 feet of it.

Crystal Body (Quartz). This creatures AC is increased by +2, and an additional +1 for every rank above its base rank it is summed at.

Crystal Body (Ruby). This creature increases its attacks damage die rolled by 1 step.

Crystal Body (Sapphire). Once per turn, If this creatures attack result is 5 or higher than its targets AC, treat that attack as a critical hit

Crystal Body (Topaz). When this creature uses a Recharge ability, its summoner regains 4 Hardness.

Crystal Ascension

15th Level Clan Feature

The ultimate expression of the beauty and power of crystal release. You not only create crystals; you infuse yourself with them.

As a Bonus action, while within 10 feet of a creature you summoned as a result of a class feature or a Jutsu you cast with the Earth release keyword, you can spend 4 Hardness, to fuse into them, becoming a single entity. When you do, you immediately begin to occupy their space as you are treated as a single creature. Record your hit points prior to fusing, this becomes your Original Hit Point Value. In your fused state, regardless of the hit points the creature or you had originally, your new fused state has 120 Hit points. You use the summoned creatures size and physical statistics (Strength, Dexterity, Constitution) while retaining your own mental statistics (Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma) as well as all of your own speed, class features, clan features, and access to only your Shoton Clan Hijutsu. You can use the summoned creatures attacks and abilities as well as any granted to it as a result of a Shoton Clan feature or Hijutsu as well as the following bonuses.

You benefit from both Crystal Weapon Dance and Crystal Aura at the same time while fused.

Your Crystal Aura radius is increased by +10 feet, while fused.

You can remain in this fused state for 1 minute, your fused hit points are reduced to 0, or you spend an Action to end the fused state. When the fused state ends, you cannot enter it again until you complete a long rest, you appear in the nearest space that can hold you, and the creature you fused with is dispelled. If the fusion ended as a result of your hit points falling to 0, any remaining damage from the triggering instance of damage, is applied to you and your Original Hit Point Value.

If a creature with 5 ranks of Crystallization take damage from a Jutsu based attack, they are treated as vulnerable to the triggering damage, instead of resistant. This condition then ends. / Creatures that are immune to being Petrified is immune to this condition. / A Crystallized creature can spend an Action, even if Petrified to make a DC 20 Constitution ability check to end this affliction.
